composition_subtypes.role: Recursive depth-first exploration of state space
Memoization of (x,y,dir,depth) to avoid redundant work

payload.core_composition_summary: DFS explores states; memoization prunes repeated subproblems, making it exponential-time vs. complete enumeration.
payload.rationale: The solution uses DFS to simulate firework splitting, and memoization via visited dict prevents exponential blow-up, a classic coordination of search + DP.
